ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENTismade       ,         municipal corporation, acting solely in its proprietary capacity, by and through its Department of Citywide Administrative Services, having an address at One Centre Street, New York, New York 10007 (herein called "Lot 1 Owner") and 41 MADISON L.P., a Delaware limited partnership, having an address at c/o Rudin Management Co. Inc., 345 Park Avenue, 33rd Floor, New York, New York 10154 (herein called “Lot 37 Owner") (each, a “Party", or collectively, “Parties"). RECITALS: A. Lot 1 Owner is the owner in fee title of certain land known as 27 Madison Avenue, New York, New York and identified on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, NewYork County (the “Tax Map") as Block 855, Lot 1, which is more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (the “Lot 1 Land"; the buildings and improvements thereon, together with any Rebuilding (hereinafter defined) future new building(s), alterations, improvements, replacements and additions thereto, collectively, the “Lot 1 Building"; the Lot 1 Land and the Lot 1 Building, collectively, the “Lot 1 Premises"). B.Lot 37 Owner is the owner in fee title of certain land known as 41 Madison Avenue, New York, New York and identified on the Tax Map as Block 855, Lot 37, which is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (the “Lot 37 Land"; the buildings and improvements, replacements and additions thereto, collectively, the “Lot 37 Building"; the Lot 37 Land and the Lot 37 Building, collectively, the “Lot 37 Premises"). C. Lot 1 Owner and 41 Madison Company, predecessor-in-interest of Lot 37 Owner, are parties to that certain Lease dated April 10, 1970, and recorded May 27, 1970 at Reel 174, Page 799 ("Lease"), and that certain Sublease dated April 10, 1970 ("Sublease"). Pursuant to the Lease, the Lot 1 Land and Lot 37 Land, by operation of law, were formed into a single zoning lot under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined). D. The Lot 1 Building has been designated by the New York City Landmarks Preservation Commission ("LPC"), pursuant to Section 25-303(a)(1) of the New York City Administrative Code, as a "landmark." E. The Lot 1 Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution, than is now available for use on the Lot 1 Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution.  F.  The Parties hereto intend, pursuant to this Agreement, to memorialize the allocation of the Lot 1 Allocated Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Lot 1 Land to the Lot 37 Land. G. The Parties are simultaneously herewith executing and entering in a Confirmatory Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions dated as of the date of this Agreement (the “Confirmatory Declaration")by the proceduresetforth inSection12-10of theZoningResolutionto memorialize
